technical_commentary: Monthly chart shows an intact multi-year Stage 2 advance (~56 to an all-time high of 473 by Mar-2026, ~8x), with higher swing highs/lows preserved throughout and both the 150- and 200-day MAs still rising; the current ~400-447 range of the past five months is a high-level consolidation sitting near the upper quartile of the stock's own 5-year range (~84th percentile), not a bottoming base and not a distribution top. Short-term technicals are genuinely soft today -- price sits below the 50/150/200-DMA cluster and is only +13% above its 52-week low versus the 30% Minervini threshold -- so the trend template fails and this isn't a fresh actionable pivot, but monthly volume has contracted roughly a third into the range with up-months outrunning down-months on volume, a constructive basing signature rather than distribution. Key levels: reclaiming 420-423 (150/200-DMA) plus the 447 range high would resume the trend; a monthly close below the Aug-2025 higher low (~368) is the first real crack in the five-year uptrend.
